Unprofessional is the only thing that comes to my mind. We are an NRI family wanting to apply for South Korean visa. We have to apply for Visa in India because as NRIs who have not completed 2 years of residency in the present foreign country of residence, have to apply for South Korean visa in the home country i.e. India.

I reached out to them to understand the documents. They bluntly told me that we cannot apply from India since all our documents are from Cambodia (where we currently live but have not completed 2 years yet).

Despite sending them the link of the Korean consulate website specifically stating the above rule for NRIs they refused to acknowledge that any such rule exists and that we have to apply on Cambodia. I also informed them that we have visited Korean Embassy in Cambodia and they told us to apply in India due the 2 year residency rule. Hana travels refused to accept it. Their "seniors" know better.

Hana travels also told me that in any case my husband's passport is issued in Uttar Pradesh. So they cannot take his application because it doesn't come under their "jurisdiction" and my husband will have to apply from Delhi. To which i asked them you can take my application as my passport is issued in Mumbai and my permanent address is also from Mumbai. To which they tell me that no, my birthplace is Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh so they cannot take my application as well. Very confused, I asked them what happens to my son's application since he was born in Seoul, South Korea and his passport was also issued in Seoul. They never answered that question. With their logic, i need to take his passport to Seoul to apply for visa for South Korea. An agency who specifically does South Korean visashas zero knowledge about how this works.

When i asked them to please connect with the consulate and clarify because i am 100% sure i cannot apply in Cambodia and i need to apply in India. They said they have consulted their "seniors" and yet again, their seniors know better. Hana travels sent me a link of the consulate website and asked me to contact them myself. A simple phone call also was too much for them to do because too arrogant to admit they have no idea what i am talking about.

I emailed the consulate, and i got a response withing minutes that i need to apply in India. I have shared the screenshot for the "learned seniors" information. No reply to that as well.

The attitude with which Hana travels spoke to me when they themselves were unaware of the rule was rather amusing. An honest hardworking agency would take it upon themselves to find out about a rule if it's come to their attention for the first time. Rather than trying to make me look dumb and do the research they are supposed to do.

I will obviously not be using their service again. And would advice you not to either. Because their lack of experience and commitment to providing basic service will get your visa rejected.

Edit 1-
If you only had taken the same amount of time as you took to write this response in finding out what needs to be done in our case, you would be professional. We have engaged another agency who will be finding everything out  for us rather than giving us a standard response that they have limitations and restrictions and jurisdictions and that you can't do it. My problem is not that you don't know what to do. It's that you dont even bother to find out. That is unprofessional. Without even understanding my case you told me that i cannot apply in India. featured_reviews.name: Jeeri Deka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wow! I just got back from the trip of a lifetime through South Africa with Passport Paradise, and I'm still buzzing from the experience! From the moment we landed in Joburg (as the locals call it), I knew we were in for something special. Our amazing trip leader Neha, who's actually the founder of Passport Paradise, made us feel like family right from our first group Christmas dinner at the 11th floor.

Let me tell you - this wasn't your typical touristy schedule. Sure, we hit the must-sees like Table Mountain, the V&A Waterfront, Cape of Good Hope in Cape Town, but Neha took us to hidden gems that most visitors miss. We found ourselves sipping sundowners at sunset cruise, watching the sun paint the sky in incredible colors. And the food? Don't even get me started on the mouth-watering food!

The absolute highlight had to be our time in Kruger. We stayed at the luxurious Radisson, where we could see Impalas from the room balcony! Our private game drives were incredible - we spotted an incredible amount of wildlife within just two days, and our ranger shared fascinating stories about local wildlife conservation efforts. One evening, we even had a sunset drinks with the Giraffes and Zebras.

Back in Cape Town, we explored the Cape Winelands, enjoying private tastings at iconic estate - Stellenbosch. The sunset cruise around the Cape Peninsula was unforgettable - we even spotted some playful seals and penguins! Between activities, we stayed at absolutely gorgeous hotels, which honestly felt more like living in luxury homes than hotels.

What made everything extra special was Neha's personal touch and attention to details. She isn't just knowledgeable about travelling - she's passionate about it. She knew exactly what she was doing and crafted an memorial experience.

If you're dreaming of exploring South Africa, you absolutely need to check out Passport Paradise. They've nailed the perfect mix of luxury and authentic local experiences. I'm already planning my next trip with them ! 🦁✨

featured_reviews.review_text:
Tour : Rann of Kutch 6 Feb to 13 Feb 2026
The tour was very well designed by Anubhav team. The itinerary covered popular spots like the Rann, Road to Heaven , Dholavira Harrapan site, Kala Dungar, Palace as well as off beat spots like fossil park , Banni Grassland bird watching with bonnet breakfast , visits to local master craftmen and art museum, visit to local farms and orchards, local village food experience at Dholavira village etc. The hotels for stay were great. The Devpur Heritage Homestay was great experience . The tour was well executed , special mention of the friendly and efficient tour manager Raju Bhide. We made great friends during the tour and hope to keep in touch. Overall a lovely memorable tour.

featured_reviews.name: sujata potdar
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a scenic trek tour. Enjoyed the nature trails, home stays n yummy food. Was disappointed after receiving the message that morning safari at Mohan gate was canceled due to animal attack. Instead of that they arranged for mountain tour, which was more exciting. In all the tour was awesome n the arrangements made were good. Thanks to Anubhav Vacations for the offbeat tour which is their speciality.
The tour went very smooth because of our tour manager Trushal, a very enthu n considerate boy. He took care of each one of us. He has the capability of handling different personalities in a thoughtful manner. Thank u Trushal for ur efforts.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Food throuout the trip was very good including local food like rajma, paratha, choole, also extra surprise added Sabudana wada for upvas, khekda bhaji, batata wada(Abhishek group leader special) were as good as we could get in Pune. Trip included sight seeing as well as walks in the nature👌 lots of photo opportunities.

featured_reviews.name: Raghav Gholkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Me, Raghav Gholkar joined Kinnaur tour starting 10th April 2026. This is my first trip with Anubhav. It was a unique experience. The places visited in Himachal Pradesh were full of natural beauty and less explored by tourist. Tour programme was well planned. The stay arrangment was comfortable at all places. The food at all hotels were tasty. They had also served the special local cuisine which was good surprise.

The tour manager Mr Rohit had taken good care of all members and was very much helpful.

The only suggestion is to consider having a comfortable seating type vehicle for travel taking into account the number of tour members, their luggage and conditions of road. The one in which we had travelled, the seats were not comfortable.

However the driver of our vehicle was very skillful and drove cautiously throughout the tour.

Thank you Anubhav Travel and tours
